title: Shippuu Mahou Daisakusen: Kingdom·Grandprix
overview:
Glittering magic, roaring exhaust! In this race with no rules, anyone who gets in the way gets a free invitation to hell. Only one can claim victory. I'll hit them all with a bomb and leave them in the dust!

To lift the spirits of his war-torn land, the king calls a grand race across the continent. This arcade shooter is part vertical shoot-'em-up and part race: blast enemies and bosses while competing against rival racers for the finish line. Shove rivals into walls and enemy fire, knock them back with bombs, and earn tournament points for placing in the top four of each stage.

Push toward the top of the screen to accelerate, at the cost of less time to react. Magic items power up your shot and add frontal or homing attacks, a speed boost lets you surge ahead, and each racer has their own weapons and flashy bomb.

- 12 stages packed with distinctive bosses
- Eight racers, each with three shot types and a unique bomb
- One or two players at once, racing on the same screen
- Arcade mode with the original vertical screen layout, plus a Saturn mode reworked for a horizontal display
- Five difficulty levels

きらめく魔法、うなるエキゾースト！
ルール無用のこのレース、邪魔する奴は地獄へ無料御招待。勝利を得るのは只一人。
ボンバー1発食らわせて、俺がまとめてぶっちぎり！
